user.title: Add RSS Feed
user.description: Configure an RSS or Atom feed to monitor. You can customize advanced options after setup.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this feed
data_description.feed_url: The URL of the RSS or Atom feed

error.invalid_url: Invalid feed URL. Please enter a valid URL.

data_description.date_format: Select how dates should be displayed
data_description.local_time: Convert feed dates to your local timezone
data_description.show_topn: Maximum number of entries to display (set to 0 or leave empty for unlimited)
data_description.remove_summary_image: Remove HTML image tags from summary text
data_description.inclusions: Comma-separated list of fields to include (leave empty for all)
data_description.exclusions: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude
data_description.scan_interval_value: How often to check for updates
